import AlgebraicJacobian.Cohomology.CechSectionIdentificationLegMid1
universe u
open CategoryTheory Limits
namespace AlgebraicGeometry
variable {X : Scheme.{u}}

noncomputable def interLegHomφ (𝒰 : X.OpenCover) {p q : ℕ}
    (φ : SimplexCategory.mk p ⟶ SimplexCategory.mk q) (σ' : Fin (q + 1) → 𝒰.I₀) :
    Over.mk (Scheme.Opens.ι (coverInterOpen 𝒰 σ')) ⟶
      Over.mk (Scheme.Opens.ι (coverInterOpen 𝒰 (σ' ∘ φ.toOrderHom))) :=
  Over.homMk (X.homOfLE (le_iInf (fun l' => iInf_le (fun j => coverOpen 𝒰 (σ' j))
    (φ.toOrderHom l')))) (Scheme.homOfLE_ι _ _)

set_option maxHeartbeats 1600000 in
lemma interLegHomφ_interProj (𝒰 : X.OpenCover) {p q : ℕ}
    (φ : SimplexCategory.mk p ⟶ SimplexCategory.mk q) (σ' : Fin (q + 1) → 𝒰.I₀)
    (l : Fin (p + 1)) :
    interLegHomφ 𝒰 φ σ' ≫ interProj 𝒰 (σ' ∘ φ.toOrderHom) l
      = interProj 𝒰 σ' (φ.toOrderHom l) := by
  have hfac : X.homOfLE (le_iInf (fun l' => iInf_le (fun j => coverOpen 𝒰 (σ' j))
        (φ.toOrderHom l'))) ≫ coverInterToMember 𝒰 (σ' ∘ φ.toOrderHom) l
      = coverInterToMember 𝒰 σ' (φ.toOrderHom l) := by
    haveI : IsOpenImmersion (𝒰.f (σ' (φ.toOrderHom l))) := inferInstance
    refine IsOpenImmersion.lift_uniq (𝒰.f (σ' (φ.toOrderHom l)))
      (Scheme.Opens.ι (coverInterOpen 𝒰 σ')) ?_ _ ?_
    refine (Category.assoc _ _ _).trans ?_
    refine (congrArg (fun w => X.homOfLE (le_iInf (fun l' => iInf_le
        (fun j => coverOpen 𝒰 (σ' j)) (φ.toOrderHom l'))) ≫ w)
      (coverInterToMember_fac 𝒰 (σ' ∘ φ.toOrderHom) l)).trans ?_
    exact Scheme.homOfLE_ι _ _
  apply Over.OverMorphism.ext
  exact (Category.assoc _ _ _).symm.trans
    (congrArg (fun w => w ≫ Sigma.ι 𝒰.X (σ' (φ.toOrderHom l))) hfac)

lemma nerveφ_backboneProj (𝒰 : X.OpenCover) {p q : ℕ}
    (φ : SimplexCategory.mk p ⟶ SimplexCategory.mk q) (l : Fin (p + 1)) :
    (coverCechNerveOver 𝒰).map φ.op ≫ backboneProj 𝒰 p l =
      backboneProj 𝒰 q (φ.toOrderHom l) := by
  apply Over.OverMorphism.ext
  exact WidePullback.lift_π (fun _ : Fin (p + 1) => Sigma.desc 𝒰.f) _ _ _ l

set_option maxHeartbeats 1600000 in
/-- **THE GENERAL-φ ANALOGUE OF `backboneIncl_nerveδ`.** -/
lemma backboneIncl_nerveφ (𝒰 : X.OpenCover) [Finite 𝒰.I₀] {p q : ℕ}
    (φ : SimplexCategory.mk p ⟶ SimplexCategory.mk q) (σ' : Fin (q + 1) → 𝒰.I₀) :
    backboneIncl 𝒰 q σ' ≫ (coverCechNerveOver 𝒰).map φ.op =
      interLegHomφ 𝒰 φ σ' ≫ backboneIncl 𝒰 p (σ' ∘ φ.toOrderHom) := by
  apply backbone_hom_ext
  intro l
  rw [Category.assoc, nerveφ_backboneProj, backboneIncl_proj, Category.assoc,
    backboneIncl_proj, interLegHomφ_interProj]

set_option maxHeartbeats 1600000 in
/-- **THE GENERAL-φ COORDINATE FORMULA** — the analogue the r4 docstrings assert does not exist
anywhere in the workspace or in mathlib. -/
theorem cechNerve_backbone_φ_sigma (𝒰 : X.OpenCover) [Finite 𝒰.I₀] (F : X.Modules) {p q : ℕ}
    (φ : SimplexCategory.mk p ⟶ SimplexCategory.mk q) (σ' : Fin (q + 1) → 𝒰.I₀) :
    (pushPull_sigma_iso 𝒰 F p).hom ≫
        Pi.π (fun τ : Fin (p + 1) → 𝒰.I₀ =>
          pushPullObj F (Over.mk (Scheme.Opens.ι (coverInterOpen 𝒰 τ)))) (σ' ∘ φ.toOrderHom) ≫
        pushPullMap F (interLegHomφ 𝒰 φ σ')
      = pushPullMap F ((coverCechNerveOver 𝒰).map φ.op) ≫
          (pushPull_sigma_iso 𝒰 F q).hom ≫
          Pi.π (fun τ : Fin (q + 1) → 𝒰.I₀ =>
            pushPullObj F (Over.mk (Scheme.Opens.ι (coverInterOpen 𝒰 τ)))) σ' := by
  rw [← Category.assoc, pushPull_sigma_iso_π_incl, pushPull_sigma_iso_π_incl,
    ← pushPullMap_comp, ← pushPullMap_comp, backboneIncl_nerveφ]

end AlgebraicGeometry

#print axioms AlgebraicGeometry.cechNerve_backbone_φ_sigma
#print axioms AlgebraicGeometry.backboneIncl_nerveφ
#print axioms AlgebraicGeometry.interLegHomφ_interProj
#print axioms AlgebraicGeometry.nerveφ_backboneProj
